title: Phased MVP for Route Cost Explorer: minimal tiles + deferred deep tracing
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Context: The original Route Cost Explorer PRD envisioned a deep interactive heatmap, per-route token attribution, and span-level trace joins. Given time and cost constraints for the next Console MVP, we are cutting the feature into a phased delivery. Phase 1 (this ticket) delivers a minimal set of dashboard tiles and a sampled trace link surface that surfaces high-cost routes and top contributing models; Phase 2 (follow-up) will implement the interactive heatmap, span joins, and long-term retention/backfill. This ticket documents scope decisions, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and follow-ups.
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff w/ Eng, DX, Design. Agreed to prioritize three tiles: Route P95 latency, Route cost per 1k tokens, Top 10 routes by spend.
2026-03-02: Eng flagged large storage cost for per-request attribution; proposed sampled attribution + link to trace sampling instead of full attribution export.
2026-03-03: Design produced compact tile mocks (compact cards with micro sparkline + single metric). Designer review approved compact style for MVP.
2026-03-04: PM decision: defer interactive heatmap and per-span joins to Phase 2. Added dependency ENG-1842 (tracing sample API) to unblock sampled links.
2026-03-05: Updated acceptance criteria based on Eng feedback around retention and query latency targets.
Post-launch note: add a follow-up ticket to enable backfill pipeline if customer demand is high.
Linked artifacts: PRD v0.6, design mocks, sample query dashboard (links below).
acceptance_criteria: Three dashboard tiles visible under Console > Insights > Route Cost: (1) Route P95 latency (30d), (2) Cost per 1k tokens (30d), (3) Top 10 routes by spend (30d).
Each tile renders within 800ms for 95% of requests in staging with production-like data volume.
Tiles include a compact sparkline for last 30 days and a link labeled 'Inspect sample traces' that opens the trace explorer filtered to that route.
Trace link uses sampling API to pre-filter up to 50 sample traces per route; clicking a trace opens full trace in Trace UI with preserved filter params.
No per-request export or per-token attribution is generated for Phase 1; logs contain a sampling tag for later backfill if required.
Instrumentation: route_id tag present on sampled traces and cost tiles emit the same route_id for cross-join (logs and traces consistent).
Cost delta guardrail: UI shows a warning banner when the estimated daily compute cost of the tile query exceeds configured threshold (> $5/day in staging config).
E2E tests: a synthetic dataset demonstrates tile values and trace links; automated tests validate link params and tile rendering under sampling enabled/disabled.
Documentation: PRD summary and 'How to interpret Route Cost tiles' added to Console docs site before release.
Rollout: Feature flag gate present; rollout to 10% orgs for 48h, monitor cost delta and tile errors; rollback capability validated.
decisions: Defer per-request token-level attribution and interactive heatmap to Phase 2 due to storage and query cost risk.
Adopt sampling-based trace links for MVP to reduce ingestion/retention cost and still enable investigative workflows.
Use compact tile visual style to reduce engineering surface area for layout and accessibility testing.
Expose a cost-guardrail in staging to detect runaway queries before GA.
Require ENG-1842 (tracing sample API) and ENG-2711 (tile query optimization) to be completed or feature-flagged-off before rollout.
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind 'route_cost_explorer_mvp' FF; default off.
Stage A: internal-only rollout for 24h to validate metrics and edge cases.
Stage B: 10% customer sampling for 48h. Monitor: tile render latency, trace link failures, daily estimated cost delta.
Stage C: 50% and then 100% contingent on no major regressions and acceptable cost profile.
Rollback: Flip FF off and trigger emergency job to remove scheduled tile queries if cost spike > 3x baseline.
Post-rollout: create Phase 2 ticket with heatmap/backfill requirements and customer feedback binding.
qa_test_plan: Synthetic dataset validation: seed 5k synthetic requests across 20 routes. Validate top-10 spend ordering matches offline calc.
Trace link flow: click 'Inspect sample traces' for a route in staging; ensure 1-50 traces open with correct route_id filter.
Load test: simulate concurrent tile renders in staging at 200 RPS and assert 95th pct render < 800ms and error rate < 1%.
Cost-gate test: manipulate query planner to exceed staging threshold and assert warning banner appears and flag metrics alert fires.
Accessibility smoke: tiles pass color contrast and keyboard-navigation checks per AX guidelines.
